title: No regrets, and learning bass drum and horn in the country
summary: Punch says he never wanted to do anything but play music, and ran away from cutting cane. Working in the fields, Punch got the bass drum from the town brass band and taught himself horn; he says he taught Red Allen and Red's father taught him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
